messages:
Maya Patel: Quick FYI — vendor updated ETA for Wave 3 racks to next Tue EOD. Can owners confirm reservation -> rack mapping and whether the canary window still works?
Vic Chen: Thanks. I can confirm the reserved capacity IDs but still waiting on final manifest from procurement (missing rack U positions). Can we get the manifest by tomorrow morning? :eyes:
Samir Rao: Procurement said partial manifest is attached to ticket 4621 — they shipped 6/8 racks so far. Power PSUs still TBD. I pinged vendor for slot-level manifest.
Charlie O'Neil: Re: canary — we planned a 4hr canary with 50 qps traffic. If only 6 racks arrive we might need to drop to 30 qps or split canary into two passes. Ops preference?
Lisa G: ops-qa: prefer two short passes if risk is higher. That gives time to validate telemetry per-cabinet.
Maya Patel: @Vic @Samir can you update the reservation service mapping after you get manifest? Also pinging @Charlie to queue canary plan adjustments.
Vic Chen: Will update mapping once manifest arrives. Also flag: firmware baseline mismatch on two nodes (r7.2 vs r7.4) — that's a gating item for canary unless we set fallback.
Samir Rao: Noted. Vendor offered to reflash before shipment but that would push timeline a day. Do we accept or use runtime fallback?
Charlie O'Neil: Runtime fallback seems safer for schedule. Canary first on flashed nodes then fallback to others. But need a PR to adjust reservation allocation. Samir can you own the PR?
Samir Rao: Yep, I can open PR. Drafted branch: samir/alloc-fallback. CC @Maya.
Maya Patel: Please reference the reservation IDs in the PR and add a brief note about power/circuit checks.
Samir Rao: PR #8123 created: https://git.internal/rw/infra/pulls/8123 — updates allocation logic and canary tag. Small config change:
```
- default_canary_qps: 50
+ default_canary_qps: dynamic_by_rack
```
Maya Patel: Nice. @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary run once the PR is merged and manifest attached to ticket 4621?
deploy-bot: Canary job queued (job id cj-7721). Will run after merge and manifest attachment.
Charlie O'Neil: I'll adjust the canary playbook to two passes and add thermal/telemetry checkpoints at 15 and 60 minutes.
Lisa G: ops-qa: once jobs run, we'll do a quick smoke checklist: 1) token-level latency 2) outlier GPU temp 3) reservation failover 4) KV cache hit rate.
Maya Patel: Great. Blockers summary: 1) full manifest (procurement) 2) firmware mismatch decision (vendor vs runtime fallback) 3) power circuit confirmation for racks 4) PR merge + canary schedule. Owners: manifest -> Samir/Procurement, firmware -> Vic/vendor, circuits -> Infra-ops, PR -> Samir, Canary -> Charlie/ops-qa. Please ack with :thumbsup: when you've got it.
Vic Chen: :thumbsup: I got it and will coordinate with vendor on firmware.
Samir Rao: :thumbsup: updating ticket 4621 now.
Charlie O'Neil: :thumbsup: will update playbook and monitor cj-7721.
Lisa G: :thumbsup: ops-qa standing by for runs.
Maya Patel: Thanks team — I'll follow up EOD with a roll-forward plan if manifest is delayed.
